artistic.name: Artistic
artistic.trait: This shows a strong ability for visual innovation, creative expression and communicating through images.
artistic.complement: Your creative side also helps you propose original solutions.

social.name: Social
social.trait: This shows that you enjoy helping, teaching and working with people, and that you are driven by having a positive impact.
social.complement: Your social orientation also lets you connect with users' needs and work as a team.

investigative.name: Investigative
investigative.trait: This shows intellectual curiosity and ease for analysing information and solving complex problems.
investigative.complement: Your analytical thinking also helps you support your decisions.

enterprising.name: Enterprising
enterprising.trait: This shows initiative, leadership and ease for persuading others and leading projects.
enterprising.complement: Your enterprising profile also pushes you to lead and turn ideas into projects.

conventional.name: Conventional
conventional.trait: This shows that you are organised, methodical and perform very well in tasks that require precision.
conventional.complement: Your sense of order also helps you plan and reach goals.
